title: The human mind is a route of presiding occasions in the brain

statements.text: In higher animals there is central direction, which suggests that each animal body harbors a living person. In the brain, a peculiar richness of inheritance is enjoyed now by one part and now by another, which produces the presiding occasion of the moment. The mind is the enduring object formed by inheritance from presiding occasion to presiding occasion, a route that probably wanders from part to part of the brain.

sources.quote: in the case of the higher animals there is central direction, which suggests that in their case each animal body harbours a living person, or living persons
This route of presiding occasions probably wanders from part to part of the brain
The human mind is thus conscious of its body inheritance.
